title: Show --model on krn worker send in the lead skill
body: Outcome: .agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md step 5 shows krn worker send with [--model <id>] [--effort <level>], matching src/worker/cli.ts and the ADR 0014 D13 amendment (model and effort explicit per turn).
